blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 26196664 (2026-10-15T08:17:23Z; hash 0x1d9a5e0db4037391462bf5be8686b4ad1e0077cb253c7d200e91bfe5e2d39e04), all four gates are zero. The receiveShares, sendShares and receiveAssets setters are permanently abdicated, so immutable VaultV2 prevents re-enabling local share-transfer or withdrawal gates. The sendAssets deposit gate remains configurable after 604800 seconds and does not block existing holders' withdrawals. Parent RLUSD blacklist/pause and reserve-access powers remain inherited. Liquidity routing and lending losses are separate risks.

oracleRisk.summary: VaultV2 NAV is onchain idle-plus-adapter accounting; the only funded lending market is RLUSD/WBTC at 86% LLTV. Its immutable MorphoChainlinkOracleV2 0xf58725eb213161e9054c97f970dc80b2d0327e8d composes Chainlink WBTC/BTC, BTC/USD and RLUSD/USD feeds. The local borrower branch is applicable despite oracle-free share arithmetic; no feed failover or consumer staleness bound exists in the reviewed oracle source.

branches.fallbackBehavior: No alternate feed or failover: price() directly composes the configured latestRoundData answers. ChainlinkDataFeedLib checks nonnegative answers but deliberately does not check updatedAt or min/max bounds; no consumer staleness bound is claimed.

collateralParameters.note: Immutable market LLTV, not a claim that every borrower currently uses this LTV.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Permissionless Morpho liquidation when borrower LTV exceeds 86%; liquidator repays debt in exchange for collateral plus the protocol-defined LLTV-dependent incentive.
branches.backstop: Borrower WBTC collateral and permissionless liquidation are the reviewed recovery resources; no independently funded exact-vault insurance or external recovery guarantee is established.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Morpho bad debt reduces market supplier assets after collateral exhaustion. Adapter realAssets reports the reduced position; VaultV2 accrual socializes losses through lower assets per share. No administrator-set price fallback is present in this oracle.
